governing_authority.cite: Herrera v. City of Miami, 600 So. 2d 561 (Fla. 3d DCA 1992)
governing_authority.proposition: A variance applicant must demonstrate an exceptional and unique hardship to the individual landowner not shared by other property owners in the area; a self-created hardship will not support a variance.

caption_request.title: Caption and Request
caption_request.instruction: Formal caption: deciding body as entered by the user, parcel/address, zoning district, and the variance requested. One paragraph.

hardship_showing.title: Hardship Showing
hardship_showing.instruction: The applicant carries the burden throughout. Argue the legal hardship from the user's facts, showing it is exceptional and unique to this property and not self-created, consistent with Herrera v. City of Miami, 600 So. 2d 561 (Fla. 3d DCA 1992). Use only facts the user supplied.

criteria_compliance.title: Criterion-by-Criterion Compliance
criteria_compliance.instruction: One numbered subsection per user-entered criterion row, IN ORDER. Recite each criterion VERBATIM inside the criterion markers exactly as shown in the ABSOLUTE RULES (nothing else between them), then argue it is satisfied using the user's evidence. NEVER invent or paraphrase criterion text. Blank evidence -> visible bracketed placeholder, never fabricated.

record_preservation.title: Record Preservation
record_preservation.instruction: Request that the letter and attachments be entered into the hearing record; variance proceedings are quasi-judicial and reviewed by certiorari on the record.

signature_block.title: Signature Block
signature_block.instruction: Professional signature block for the applicant with a [DATE] placeholder.
